title: App bar search
summary: A search field for a shell's header row: a pill on a wide screen, results in a floating panel below it; below the phone breakpoint the pill collapses to an icon button that expands to a full-width field over the header row. Debounces typing into pk-query; the host supplies items (results) and reads pk-select when one is chosen. Closes itself when the containing pk-app-shell's nav drawer opens, on Escape and on browser navigation.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the field and the expand button.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before raising pk-query.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Below the phone breakpoint, whether the field covers the header row. No effect above it (the field is always shown there).

props.name: items
props.description: Results: { id, label, group?, sub?, thumbnail?, badge? }[]. A JSON attribute or a property, like pk-table's rows. Adjacent items with the same group get one heading between them; the host is responsible for the order.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: The message shown when items is empty and the field has text.

events.name: pk-query
events.description: The field's text, debounce milliseconds after the last keystroke. The host fetches or filters and sets items in response; this element never searches itself.

events.name: pk-select
events.description: A result was chosen (click or Enter). The host decides what happens; this element does not navigate.

events.name: pk-toggle
events.description: expanded changed by itself (the expand or collapse button, Escape, the shell's drawer opening, a navigation). Not raised for a change the host made.

parts.name: expand
parts.description: The icon button shown below the phone breakpoint.

parts.name: collapse
parts.description: The close button shown while expanded, below the phone breakpoint.

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: A result's thumbnail (dynamic; shown when the item has one).

parts.name: badge
parts.description: A result's badge text (dynamic; shown when the item has one).

parts.name: row
parts.description: A result row's label and subtitle column (dynamic).

parts.name: row-sub
parts.description: A result's subtitle text (dynamic; shown when the item has one).

a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox: role=combobox on the input, aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant (focus stays on the input). Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes the results, then a second Escape collapses the field below the phone breakpoint. The expand and collapse buttons are 44px touch targets.
mobile: Below the phone breakpoint the field is an icon button; tapping it covers the header row with a full-width field and a close button. The results panel is full width below it.
